messages:
jules: lunchtime micro-game  each person drops ONE song (3-5min) that pairs with a short TV episode or film under 45min. no repeats, no long playlists. bonus if the pairing is silly. ready, go! :pizza:
ryan: okay i'll start:
- Song: Phoebe Bridgers - Kyoto (3:05)
- Pairing: "The Entire History of You" (Black Mirror S1E3, ~44min)  intense, watch after the chorus.
emily: love that. mine:
- Song: The Velvet Underground - Pale Blue Eyes (3:40)
- Pairing: "Paterson" (short-ish mood cut; not under 45 but a single quiet episode vibe)  fine ok pick: "Night on Earth" (short film segments)  pick the Paris bit (~12min) for that mellow tinge.
carlos: keeping it absurd:
- Song: Beck - Wow (3:19)
- Pairing: "Bandersnatch" choose the worst decision route (approx ~20-30min depending)  chaos + groove. :video_game:
zara: soft & cozy:
- Song: Vashti Bunyan - Train Song (2:51)
- Pairing: "Paris, Je T'aime"  pick one short segment (~5-10min) for bite-sized romance.
jules: last one from me:
- Song: Arthur Russell - This Is How We Walk On The Moon (4:26)
- Pairing: stop-motion short "The House of Small Cubes" (~12min)  oddly wistful, matches the mellow drift.
ryan: jukebox-bot, can you queue these individually and make a single "one-song-swap" ephemeral playlist? link pls.
jukebox-bot: queued songs to ephemeral playlist "one-song-swap-1768001234" (link: https://open.spotify/placeholder) and pinned pairings to #random-links. Reminder: informal watch party at 12:45 for anyone on lunch break. :alarm_clock:
emily: ill pop in for Bandersnatch chaos after a sandwich. :sandwich:
carlos: whoops now i'm hyped for horrible choices. :sweat_smile:
zara: bringing peppermint tea to the mini viewing.
jules: perfect. also vote: keep this as a lunchtime thing weekly? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :shrug: for not this often.
ryan: :thumbsup:
emily: :thumbsup:
carlos: :thumbsup:
zara: :thumbsup:
jukebox-bot: weekly micro-game scheduled for Fridays at 12:30 starting 2024-06-14T12:30:00Z (opt-out with `@jukebox-bot unsubscribe`).
